title: [dynamo, benchmarks] record ops captured and eager fallbacks in expected accuracy CSVs
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* #171826
* #163503
* #185524
* #186100
* #191389
* __->__ #191804

Regenerate the `ci_expected_accuracy` baselines so they carry the coverage
metrics added earlier in this stack (`calls_captured`, `fallbacks_to_eager`), which
`check_graph_breaks.py` skips while a baseline lacks the column. Values come from
the completed inductor accuracy run on this stack, i.e. they are pre-NGB: this
commit sits below the nested-graph-breaks default flip, which will shift
`graph_breaks`/`calls_captured` for many models and needs its own regeneration.

Only the suites whose accuracy shards ran are refreshed -- `cpu_inductor_*` and
`inductor_*` for huggingface/timm/torchbench. The remaining baselines
(aot_inductor, dynamic_*, dynamo_eager, aot_eager and rocm) keep the
`graph_breaks`-only header, so their coverage metrics stay inert until those
shards are regenerated.

`accuracy` and `graph_breaks` are unchanged for every model: the diff is purely the
two added columns. The one exception is `XGLMForCausalLM` in
inductor_huggingface_training, which OOM'd in this run; it is a known flaky model
(already in `check_graph_breaks.flaky_models`), so its `pass`/`6` baseline is kept
and its coverage cells are left empty -- an empty cell reads back as NaN and is
skipped, rather than recording an unrepresentative count from a truncated run.

One cell does not come from that run: `moco`s `fallbacks_to_eager` in
inductor_torchbench_inference was 0 there but is 2 on current main, so the CI
check flagged it (the metric is exact-matched). Verified against the
inductor_torchbench artifact of a clean main run that main itself reports 2, with
`calls_captured` and `graph_breaks` unchanged, so this is upstream drift rather
than anything in this stack; the cell is set to 2. A sweep of every model in both
torchbench CSVs found no other stale coverage cell, and the remaining suites
passed their accuracy checks unchanged.

Test Plan:

```
python benchmarks/dynamo/check_graph_breaks.py --actual <run csv> --expected <regenerated csv>
```

Verified the regenerated CSVs parse, that comparing a baseline against itself is
clean, and that the blanked XGLMForCausalLM coverage cells are skipped by the
NaN guard. Diffed the old and new CSVs on (name, accuracy, graph_breaks) to
confirm zero drift beyond the added columns.

Authored with assistance from Claude Code.
